answer: Each agent claims a terrace work slot with a 70-credit deposit and a jade token. The ledger lists each holder and its last task, one key per slot. A mirror audit replays the ledger: an idle slot, or two identities sharing one key, burns the deposit and frees the slot, killing a rented-slot ring. The k-th fake costs 40+8(k-1) credits: 1,000 fakes pay 4,036,000 and lock 70,000 against a 40,000 reward. Honest agents pay 40 once and keep the slot.
